source.title: ps-CALR: Periodic-Shift Cosine Annealing Learning Rate for Deep Neural Networks
source.authors: O. V. Johnson; Xin-Ying Chew; K. Khaw; Ming-Ha Lee

record.file_problem: The supplied text is a full article, though the prepublication copy has placeholder publication dates and a malformed flattened results table.
record.tranche_reason: Reports comparative classification results for CNN and MLP classifiers and for optimizers, using accuracy rather than training-test generalization gaps.
record.gate_note: The paper benchmarks learning-rate schedules and reports classifier and optimizer comparisons. It does not test random-label memorization, width, batch-size sweeps, dropout effects, sharpness measures, or removal of memorized examples.
record.test_reason: The study reports held-out accuracy comparisons between custom CNNs and MLPs, and between adaptive optimizers and SGD, under new training recipes. These results bear on V3 and V4 despite the paper's main focus on learning-rate schedules. It is not an original source for either version.
record.authors_conclusion: The record accurately summarizes the authors' conclusion: they claim ps-CALR improves performance over fixed learning rates and existing cosine annealing across their experiments, and is less adaptable to SGD than to Adam and RMSprop. Their improvement claim needs the exception already acknowledged in Section IV.A: MLP CIFAR100 accuracy falls from 0.2683 with Adam+CALR to 0.2664 with Adam+ps-CALR.
record.recipe_differences: The study compares learning-rate schedules and optimizers, not the interventions or measurements in the original claim versions; it uses custom MLP/CNN classifiers and pretrained models on natural datasets.
record.method_sensitivity: Results vary by dataset, classifier, optimizer, and learning-rate schedule. The authors note that warm-up epoch choice may depend on application complexity and initial learning rate.

fits_no_version.finding: With ps-CALR on CIFAR10, Adam exceeds RMSprop for both the MLP and CNN.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Adam can outperform RMSprop under this learning-rate schedule.

record.problems: No uncertainty estimates are reported. Training accuracy and training-test gaps are not tabulated. The CNN/MLP comparison uses different architectures and is not a controlled isolation of local connectivity. Table VI contains malformed SGD values and a mislabeled table caption; the paper's explicit accuracy comparison text is used where available.
record.rows_left_out: No additional directly relevant image-classifier rows were included beyond the matched Adam+ps-CALR CNN/MLP comparisons for V3 and the CIFAR10 optimizer comparisons for V4. Other datasets and schedule combinations in Tables III–VI were omitted to keep the record focused on the claim versions and within the row limit.

untested.parts: Random-label fitting and its coexistence with natural-label generalization.
Width sweeps beyond zero training error and interpolation-threshold behavior.
Attribution to local connectivity, learned sparse connections, and initialization from trained convolutional networks.
Systematic optimizer-specific tuning, language benchmarks, equal or better training performance, broader tuning, decoupled weight decay, and switching from Adam to SGD.
Controlled batch-size comparisons and adaptations that remove large-batch penalties.
Dropout ablations, small-data effects, excessive dropout, and interactions with augmentation and weight decay.
Measured magnitude-aware sharpness, its correlation with generalization gaps, and comparisons with other measures.
Identifying and removing memorized examples versus random removal.

record.verdict_notes: Other datasets and schedule combinations are explicitly declared omitted in rows_left_out, so they are not listed as missing. The CNN CIFAR10 optimizer verdict remains unresolved because of malformed SGD values. No uncertainty estimates or systematic optimizer-specific learning-rate search are reported. Schematic flat-minima illustrations do not test V7.

versions.untested_parts: Random-label memorization and natural-label generalization coexistence.
Local-connectivity attribution, learned sparse connections, and convolutional initialization of fully connected networks.
Language benchmarks, broader tuning, decoupled weight decay, switching from Adam to SGD, and training-performance comparisons.
Batch-size effects and adaptations to large-batch training.
Dropout comparisons and interactions with data augmentation.
Magnitude-aware sharpness and comparisons with other generalization measures.
Removing memorized examples and measuring the effect on test accuracy.

relationships.condition: Custom CNN versus MLP on MNIST, CIFAR10, and CIFAR100 with Adam+ps-CALR
relationships.reason: CNN accuracy exceeds MLP accuracy on all three datasets: 0.9929 versus 0.9837, 0.7178 versus 0.5306, and 0.5849 versus 0.2664 (R1–R6).
relationships.display_finding: The reported higher CNN accuracy across MNIST, CIFAR10 and CIFAR100 remains unverified.

relationships.condition: Custom MLP on CIFAR10 with ps-CALR and the paper's limited optimizer configuration
relationships.reason: Adam reaches 0.5306 accuracy versus SGD's 0.5157, reversing the adaptive disadvantage in this setting (R7, R9); this does not establish how often the disadvantage occurs elsewhere.
relationships.display_finding: Adam reportedly achieved accuracy 0.5306 versus SGD's 0.5157 under the limited optimizer configuration, but this comparison remains unverified.
